messages:
marie: Quick async handoff — spotted a memory spike on the canary in eu-west ~20:10 UTC. SLOs still OK but alert flood started. Investigating; plan to warm some prefixes and bump canary memory if needed.

devops-bot: [ALERT] canary-pod-memory > 85% (pod/canary-7f8b) — 2026-03-17T20:10:12Z

ben: On it, looking at grafana dashboards. Do we see batcher backlog or KV eviction churn at the same time?

sam: Pulling autoscaler & eviction logs now. Quick skim shows a short burst of requests from perf-tests around 20:08. Possible correlation.

anya: If this is perf-tests, we can mute noise with a short debounce (2m) but elevate to pager if >95% for 5m. We should avoid hiding real degradation. :warning:

marie: Agreed. Proposed action items: 1) warm leaderboard KV prefixes (reduce cold cache misses), 2) bump canary memory limit from 4Gi -> 6Gi temporarily, 3) add alert debounce + pager threshold. Ben — can you handle #2? Sam — can you handle #3? I'll do #1.

ben: Yep. I'll open a quick k8s patch and a rollout with 1-replica canary. PR created: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/+/3456

ben: Patch snippet:

```
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: canary
spec:
  containers:
  - name: canary
    resources:
      limits:
        memory: "6Gi"
      requests:
        memory: "4Gi"
```

sam: Filed alert tweak: https://alerts.redwood/alert/8732 — debounce 2m, pager if >95% for 5m. Added a small note to the alert description referencing the canary perf-tests.

marie: Blockers: need a quick ops-approval for the memory bump (cost/limits). Also want oncall visibility in case it regresses.

anya: I approve the temporary bump for canary. I'll stay oncall until 23:00 and monitor. If it stabilizes, we revert the change in 2 hours.

ben: Rolling canary now. Will post rollout link and pod logs once up.

devops-bot: [DEPLOY] canary memory bump deployed to eu-west — rollout-id=roll-20260317-9 — 20:18:03Z

ben: Canary logs show warmup and steady memory ~58% after restart. No new alerts in the last 6m.

sam: Alert debounce in place. Will watch for any >95% escalations.

marie: Thanks — summary for handoff: warmed KV prefixes, bumped canary mem -> 6Gi (temp), alert debounce applied. Oncall: anya. If anything crosses >95% for 5m, page SRE. Otherwise we'll revert mem bump in ~2h.

anya: Got it. Ping me if noise resumes. :thumbsup:

ben: Closing loop: PR merged and rollout healthy. I'll add a tiny note in the canary runbook about perf-test isolation to avoid future noise.

marie: Nice, everyone. No blockers for me after that. Will check back before handoff.

sam: One follow-up: I'll add a grafana panel that overlays perf-test traffic with canary memory so we can spot this faster next time.

marie: Perfect. End of async update.
